top_signals.title: Weil Gotshal’s 95-Year History Careens To A Close
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Law's Roy Strom joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." US law firm Weil Gotshal & Manges collapsed this week after failed merger talks, marking the stunning downfall of a 95-year-old firm. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: A little-known biotech’s high-stakes cancer bet just paid off and its shares doubled
top_signals.summary: Genmab’s shares have doubled in three months after a string of cancer drug trial wins, strengthening its push to own more of the medicines it develops.
